examples.text: Dia tidak masuk kerja karena sakit hari ini.

draftBefore.emotion: run-down and feeling under the weather, subdued and tired
notes: Sakit covers both being sick with an illness and feeling physical pain in a specific body part. Do not confuse it with luka, which refers to a physical wound or cut.
